_doc: Guests enjoying the pools (Sergio, 06/11/2026: 'hóspedes que entrarem aproveitando a piscina e tobogã'): UMarePoolSwimWorld. Each pool, once its expansion is owned (unlock), fills by day (hours) with up to count[0] swimmers (count[1] on hot days, none in the rain or at night). A swimmer jumps in from an entry point on the edge ([x, y, yaw] on the coping, facing the water), then swims between random points inside swim_rect (x0, y0, x1, y1, world cm: the root; the body reaches 90 cm ahead and 85 behind, so the rect keeps that far from walls and ladders), keeping spacing cm body to body (look_ahead cm ahead) and away from obstacles ([x, y, radius]: the decor floats and ball), floats on the back or treads water chatting with another swimmer. water_z is the surface; *_z are actor heights above the surface per pose (calibrated on the MetaHuman bodies). People appear and leave only out of the player's sight. slide (hotel pool, tobogã): share of the newcomers that climb the slide stair instead (tools/gen_hotel.py water_slide: origin = its instance, height = deck in m), walk up at climb_speed cm/s, sit sit_seconds at ride_start (0..1 along the chute: where it has left the deck, whose planks cover its mouth), ride the chute in ride_seconds lying back feet first (torso raised recline degrees, pelvis pelvis_up cm above the chute floor; yaw = the instance's turn; run = the straight run-out in m: 4.5 in the UE model mare_water_slide, tools/ue58/gen_water_slide.py, so it ends over the water) and fly off its end at exit_speed cm/s into the water.
